river_name.name: River Name
river_name.source: THDC India Limited Official Project Profile
river_name.notes: Bhagirathi River is a principal headstream of the Ganges River, origin at Gaumukh (Gangotri Glacier).

dam_type.name: Dam Structural Type
dam_type.source: THDC / CWC Register of Large Dams (2023)
dam_type.notes: Earth core with rockfill shell designed to withstand seismic Zone V accelerations.

dam_height.name: Dam Height above Foundation
dam_height.source: THDC India Limited / Central Water Commission (CWC)
dam_height.notes: Tallest dam in India and 5th tallest dam in the world. CWC lists 260.5 m; some academic papers cite 260.0 m.

dam_crest_length.name: Dam Crest Length
dam_crest_length.notes: THDC official specification states 575 m. CWC National Register of Large Dams lists 592 m (including abutment extensions). Both values preserved for sensitivity analysis.

dam_crest_elevation.name: Dam Crest Elevation
dam_crest_elevation.notes: Provides 4.5 m freeboard above Full Reservoir Level (835.0 m / 830.0 m).

gross_storage.name: Gross Reservoir Storage Volume
gross_storage.notes: THDC lists 3,540 MCM (3.54 billion m³). NRSC Bhuvan satellite bathymetry estimates 3,530 MCM due to post-2006 reservoir sedimentation. CWC lists 3,540 MCM.

live_storage.name: Live (Effective) Storage Volume
live_storage.notes: Storage capacity between MDDL (EL 740 m) and FRL (EL 830 m).

dead_storage.name: Dead Storage Volume
dead_storage.notes: Storage below MDDL (EL 740 m) reserved for sediment accumulation over 100-year design life.

full_reservoir_level.name: Full Reservoir Level (FRL)
full_reservoir_level.notes: Normal FRL operating limit is EL 830.0 m. Maximum flood level (MWL) during extreme PMF is EL 835.0 m.

maximum_water_level.name: Maximum Water Level (MWL)
maximum_water_level.notes: Maximum permissible reservoir elevation during PMF routing.

minimum_drawdown_level.name: Minimum Drawdown Level (MDDL)
minimum_drawdown_level.notes: Lowest operating level for Francis turbines in Underground Power House.

dead_storage_level.name: Dead Storage Level (DSL)
dead_storage_level.notes: Level below which sediment deposition occurs; intake invert is above EL 720 m.

reservoir_surface_area.name: Reservoir Water Surface Area at FRL
reservoir_surface_area.notes: NRSC Satellite imagery observes 42.0 km² at EL 830 m. THDC DPR lists 45.0 km² at MWL (EL 835 m).

power_capacity.name: Tehri Hydroelectric Power Plant Capacity
power_capacity.notes: Tehri HPP Stage-I installed capacity is 1,000 MW (4 x 250 MW Francis turbines). Tehri PSP (1,000 MW Pumped Storage) adds 1,000 MW.

power_units.name: Tehri HPP Generating Units
power_units.notes: 4 vertical Francis turbine-generator units located in Underground Power House on left bank.

chute_spillway_capacity.name: Chute Spillway Discharge Capacity
chute_spillway_capacity.notes: Gated chute spillway equipped with 3 radial gates (14 m x 15.5 m each) on right bank.

shaft_spillway_capacity.name: Four Shaft Spillways Discharge Capacity
shaft_spillway_capacity.notes: 4 ungated vertical morning-glory shaft spillways (2 left bank, 2 right bank) discharging 1,740 m³/s total.

total_spillway_capacity.name: Total Design Spillway Capacity
total_spillway_capacity.notes: Sum of Chute Spillway (13,800 m³/s) + 4 Shaft Spillways (1,740 m³/s) = 15,540 m³/s.

pmf_design_discharge.name: Probable Maximum Flood (PMF) Design Inflow
pmf_design_discharge.notes: CWC official PMF design inflow is 15,540 m³/s. Recent Academic climate studies (IIT Roorkee / IISc 2024) calculate extreme climate-adjusted PMF of 21,400 m³/s under cloudburst scenarios. Both values documented for scenario modeling.
